title: I built a native Apple app for 4 platforms in one afternoon. Here’s the exact AI workflow I used.
summary: Daniel Hayes Smith reports building ClearTime with Claude Code around a shared Swift package, platform-specific design references, and golden geometry test vectors. His handoff defines which files win when references disagree, while early internal TestFlight builds let him assess behavior on real devices; the reported speed and test totals remain self-reported.
takeaway: Give agents authoritative design references and shared test vectors, define how conflicting files are resolved, and make real-device builds an early human review gate.
